column1: # Written by Claude (origin "claude"). One line per entry:  entry id|typical learner mistake|usage note
# Notes are in English. Either text column may be empty.
la:sum:verb||Irregular: sum, es, est, sumus, estis, sunt; perfect fuī.
la:et:conjunction||Et also means "also, even"; et … et means both … and.
la:res:noun||Res (fifth declension, feminine) covers thing, matter, affair and property; rēs pūblica is the state.
la:loquor:verb||Deponent: passive forms with an active meaning, loquor = I speak.
la:sequor:verb||Deponent: passive forms with an active meaning, sequor = I follow.
la:patior:verb||Deponent: passive forms with an active meaning, patior = I suffer, I allow.
la:non:particle||Non goes right before the word it negates, usually the verb.
la:possum:verb||Possum is pot- + sum: possum, potes, potest, possumus, potestis, possunt; infinitive posse.
la:eo:verb||Irregular: eō, īs, it, īmus, ītis, eunt; infinitive īre.
la:volo:verb||Irregular: volō, vīs, vult, volumus, vultis, volunt; nōlō and mālō are built on it.
la:fero:verb||Irregular: ferō, fers, fert; perfect tulī, supine lātum.
